name: live_data_drift_monitor_default
description: Default thresholds for comparing recent live/paper-trading bars across Alpaca, yfinance, and secondary sources.
review_notes: Use Alpaca as the primary source for paper sessions and compare against yfinance or a secondary feed.
Treat no-overlap and stale-provider issues as hard failures before routing new paper orders.
Investigate adjustment-mode mismatches before comparing raw and adjusted data.
Split-like close ratios should trigger corporate-action review before trusting the latest bars.
